The '''Kyrouac system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> 

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
===Non-canon content===
[[File:Vodilux-Voyages13.png|thumb|right|200px|The Vodilux sector in ''Voyages'' 13]]
The system was located in the [[Vodilux sector]]<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kyrouac]].<ref name="AAE">{{ChallengeCite|32|Alone Against the Empire|''Alone Against the Empire''|noquotes=1}}</ref>
